_comment: Per-arch HP grid for train_segmentation.py --hp-grid. Top-level keys = architecture names (must match ARCH_CFG). Each arch gets its own search space, since CNN (resnet50) and transformer (mit_b2) encoders want different lr/wd regimes. Per arch use 'grid' (cartesian product) or 'combos' (explicit list). Keys: lr, weight_decay, warmup_epochs, sched_power; lr/weight_decay override ARCH_CFG defaults. For a single shared space across all archs instead, use top-level {'grid':{...}} or {'combos':[...]}. This example = 4 (deeplab) + 3 (segformer) = 7 runs per exp.
